thread:
Hannah: Kicking off canary for cobalt-28B-int6 (quant drop-in). Quick note: seeing intermittent slow p99 and a single OOM during long-answer smoke tests. Logs below and current canary defaults.
Diego: paste the runtime excerpt? want to know if it's workspace or KV.
Hannah: log snippet:
```
E 02:11:03 oom: workspace alloc failed (req=360MB)
W 02:11:03 allocator: fragmented=true free_chunks=14 largest_free=38MB
I 02:11:04 kv_cache: size=640MB autotrim=false
```
Pri: Thanks. What were the defaults?
Hannah: canary config we rolled:
model: cobalt-28B-int6
max_new_tokens: 700
batch_size: 5
microbatch: off
kv_prefetch: eager
reserve_mb: 0
Pri: 700 and batch 5 + eager-kv explains a workspace spike on long responses. Propose conservative defaults for canary: max_new_tokens=300, batch_size=3, enable microbatching (2), set reserve_mb=200, kv_prefetch=lazy. Also add a soft-fallback: if OOM_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> route to cobalt-24B-compat.
Hannah: proposed update: max_new_tokens=300, batch_size=3, microbatch=true, microbatch_size=2, kv_prefetch=lazy, reserve_mb=200. Kicking a small synthetic bench now.
bench-bot: synthetic 5k requests with revised defaults: p95 -21%, p99 -16%, mem headroom +250MB, OOMs 0/30m, quality delta (BLEU-like) -0.45% vs fp16 baseline.
Diego: -0.45% is bigger than usual for int6; three things to verify: 1) quant calibration differences for long-context tokens, 2) microbatch ordering that may change tokenization boundaries, 3) beam/temperature defaults in the canary harness. Run a small A/B capturing identical seeds.
Hannah: running AB test with same seeds and function-calls enabled. Also splitting traffic: default -> conservative canary; long-form routes will be pinned to dedicated-28B or to 28B-int6-dedicated with higher reserve.
marshall-bot: canary deploy initiated by Hannah -> cobalt-28B-int6 @ 3% with conservative defaults. Monitoring p95/p99/oom_count/quality-regressions.
Hannah: after 90m soak: zero OOMs, p95 improved ~20%, p99 improved ~14%, AB test shows majority of quality delta concentrated on very long summaries (>600 tokens). Action: 1) keep conservative defaults in model-catalog, 2) allow dedicated-slot pin for long-form, 3) schedule focused quant-calibration run (Diego). Will post runbook and rollout plan.
